Aalborg is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. Within the context of the report, Aalborg is one of the 98 municipalities benchmarked for clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation [^src1]. Its data concerning stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is specifically utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulation (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical outcomes and performance metrics for this indicator are detailed in the report's comprehensive municipal breakdown [^src1].
